DHAKA, Jan 8, 2023 (BSS) - The government is constructing a deep seaport at Matarbari of Cox's Bazar to help the country handle growing volumes of exports and imports and ease the pressure on the country's principal sea port Chattogram.

The government is also constructing Coal-based Power Plant, LNG Terminal and development of highways.
